title: Temple of Heaven Beijing: Tickets, Hours & What to See (2026) | China Travel Expert
description:
Planning a visit to the Temple of Heaven in Beijing? This is the quick, practical guide — tickets, hours, how to get there, and the early-morning secret that most tourists miss. I'm your China Travel Expert.

The short answer: come at opening. From November 1 the park opens at 6:30am (the main halls open around 8:00), and you want the combined through-ticket, not the cheap park-only ticket. Then spend that first hour among the locals before the halls even open.

Quick facts (all figures verified 2026-11-06; prices are travel-guide figures — confirm official channels before you go):
• Completed 1420 (Yongle era), ~273 hectares — about 4x the Forbidden City; UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests: ~38 m tall, built entirely of wood with no nails; 28 pillars (4 seasons + 12 months + 12 two-hour periods). The original burned in an 1889 lightning fire and was rebuilt right afterward.
• Combined through-ticket ~¥28 off-season (Nov–Mar) / ~¥34 Apr–Oct; park-only ~¥10–15. Historic buildings closed Mondays (since Sept 2026).

🧭 Expert Tip: Set the early alarm. Between 6:30 and 8:00am the long walkway fills with tai chi, sword forms, dancing and singing — the warmest free show in Beijing.
